hero.kicker: MapForAll, the map that makes visible what the city forgets.
hero.title: Find the small businesses and accessible places near you.
hero.body: MapForAll puts local traders and places that welcome wheelchair users first — not only the big chains that are already everywhere. Any missing place can be added by the community in a few seconds.

about.quote: A small shop, fifty metres away. Invisible on every other app. Not on MapForAll.
about.body: Real local businesses and accessible places, added by the community and checked, ranked by relevance and lifted for economic inclusion.

work.title: From invisible to visible
work.body: Every business counts. MapForAll makes room for the places other algorithms forget.

demo.title: Watch MapForAll read the city
demo.body: Ask for what you need in plain words. MapForAll finds local businesses and accessible places around you, each with a clear badge. Never invented. Checked by the community.
demo.bubble: Find a local business near the stadium

a11y.deviceDesc: Demo: you ask for an accessible shop near Kimisagara, and MapForAll answers with Duka rya Jean, a step-free entrance 4 minutes away on foot.

hero2.pill: Ask a question, the map answers
hero2.sub: Small businesses and accessible places near you, added and checked by the community.

talk.ask: Find an accessible shop near Kimisagara
talk.answer: I found 3 places. Duka rya Jean has a step-free entrance, 4 min away on foot.

ticker.i5: A door wide enough for a wheelchair

access2.title: Accessibility at a glance.
